subject: Television & Streaming
title: Sherlock and Elementary: The Same Detective, Two Visions
description: One-minute skill: Sherlock and Elementary: The Same Detective, Two Visions.

hook.text: In 2010, BBC's Sherlock reimagined Holmes as a modern genius. In 2012, CBS's Elementary cast a female Watson.

buildup.text: Benedict Cumberbatch played Sherlock as exhilarating and cold.

discovery.text: Both shows proved Holmes is endlessly adaptable.

twist.text: Elementary ran seven seasons to less acclaim but explored addiction and recovery with more depth.

climax.text: Sherlock Holmes has been adapted more than any other fictional character.

punchline.text: The world's most adapted character still has new stories to tell.

quiz.question: What is Sherlock Holmes's distinction in the history of television adaptations?
options: He's the oldest character on TV
He's been adapted more than any other fictional character
